descriptions.notStarted: Things might seem rather ominous, but you must finish what you’ve started. Let’s see what the butler, who is in the Foyer, has in mind.
descriptions.inProgress: It looks like you’re fighting a girl ghost. And you also need to collect #r20 Cursed Dolls#k. You could very well be dreaming…
descriptions.completed: Yes, you did it! The ghost has been vanquished and you collected #r20 Cursed Dolls#k! Perhaps you’ve finally arrived at the end of this saga.
